verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents linking accounts, data refreshes, relinking inactive accounts, and webhooks for link and refresh events. Nothing in it documents disconnecting or deleting a Financial Connections account or user, stopping ongoing data collection, or purging held data. The axis clearly applies to a bank-data aggregation product, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
